description: Update an existing ticket's fields. Only provided fields are changed. Before changing a description, read the ticket with get_ticket first. Text a person wrote stays word for word, with anything you add below a --- line, and you edit your own earlier additions in place, so they are not stacked as dated updates. To only add below the text, use append_to_description.

assignee_ids.description: User IDs to assign, from list_people, replacing the current set

description.description: New description, replacing the whole text. Before changing a description, read the ticket with get_ticket first. Text a person wrote stays word for word, with anything you add below a --- line, and you edit your own earlier additions in place, so they are not stacked as dated updates. To only add below the text, use append_to_description.

anyOf.description: Due date as YYYY-MM-DD, on any ticket; it has to be in the future. Set one only when the person gives a date.

due_date.description: Due date as YYYY-MM-DD, on any ticket; it has to be in the future. Set one only when the person gives a date. Null to unset.

labels.description: Label names, as list_labels shows them, replacing the current set

points.description: Effort estimate in points (0, 1, 2, 3, 5, or 8): how much work the ticket takes. Not a time estimate, and not a rating of how complex or difficult the work is. Every ticket has points before it starts: estimate them yourself, or use the person's number when they give one.

project_id.description: New project external ID (null to unset)

stakeholder_id.description: New stakeholder user ID (null to unset)

state.description: Move the ticket back to the Icebox (unprioritized) or the Backlog (prioritized); tell the person where it is going first. Moving forward is transition_ticket.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.

name: update_ticket
title: Update a ticket
